shippingInstructions.selectedByBuyer: Selected and paid for by buyer
shippingInstructions.step1Description: Use packaging that's sturdy enough to protect the items) you're sending. The dimensions of your parcel should not exceed 19cm x 38cm x 64cm.
shippingInstructions.step2DescriptionDigital: If you have a digital label - there's no need to print it. Simply scan the label on your phone at the drop-off point to open the locker or show it to staff at the drop-off point.
shippingInstructions.step2DescriptionPrintable: If you have a printable label - download, print and attach it to your parcel. The barcode must be completely visible (even clear tape could prevent it from scanning) and should fit on one side of the box or envelope.
shippingInstructions.step3Title: 3. Bring the parcel to the drop-off point
shippingInstructions.step3Description: Check the nearest InPost drop-off point for their opening hours.
shippingInstructions.step3DescriptionProcess: To send your parcel, scan your (digital or printed) label at the InPost drop-off point. The locker will open automatically. Place the parcel inside, close the door, and you're done - the
shippingInstructions.step4Description: After drop-off, both you and the buyer can track the parcel via the conversation screen. Allow up to 48 hours for the information to appear on Vinted.
